scenes.title: Anomaly Detection in Data
scenes.subtitle: Finding the unexpected without fixed rules
scenes.narration: Anomaly detection flags data that deviates from learned normal behavior, catching problems that no static rule anticipated.

scenes.heading: Static thresholds vs anomaly detection
scenes.narration: Static thresholds are easy to reason about but grow stale as data trends and seasonality shift. Anomaly detection instead learns a baseline from history and adapts to expected patterns like weekly cycles. That adaptability lets it flag genuine surprises without drowning teams in false alarms on normal variation.

scenes.heading: Common techniques
bullets: Z-score: distance from a rolling mean
Rolling statistics: compare to a moving window
Seasonal decomposition: separate trend and cycle
ML models: learn multivariate normal behavior
scenes.narration: A z-score measures how many standard deviations a value sits from a rolling mean, a simple and effective start. Rolling statistics compare each point against a recent window so the baseline moves with the data. Seasonal decomposition isolates repeating cycles, and machine learning models capture more complex multivariate patterns.

scenes.heading: A z-score anomaly check
scenes.code:
import numpy as np

def zscore_anomalies(series, window=30, threshold=3.0):
    mean = series.rolling(window).mean()
    std = series.rolling(window).std()
    z = (series - mean) / std
    return series[np.abs(z) > threshold]

anomalies = zscore_anomalies(daily_row_counts)
if not anomalies.empty:
    alert(f"Volume anomaly on {list(anomalies.index)}")
scenes.narration: This function computes a rolling mean and standard deviation over a trailing window so the baseline tracks recent behavior. Each point's z-score expresses how far it strays from that baseline in units of standard deviation. Points beyond the threshold are returned as anomalies, and any hit raises an alert for review.

scenes.text: Learn what normal looks like from history so alerts fire on genuine surprises, not on ordinary variation.
scenes.narration: Anomaly detection shines where fixed thresholds fail, especially for trending or seasonal metrics. Tune the sensitivity carefully so the signal stays trustworthy.
